section: Summary of Benefits for the High Option of the Government Employees Health Association, Inc. 2026

rows.High Option Benefits: Medical services provided by physicians: Diagnostic and treatment services provided in the office
rows.You pay: In-network: $30 copay primary care provider for covered office visit; and $45 copay specialist for covered office visit Out-of-network: 50%* of covered professional services

rows.High Option Benefits: Services provided by a hospital: Inpatient
rows.You pay: In-network: $200 per day copayment, up to 5 days and 20% of the Plan allowance Out-of-network: $500 per day copayment, up to 5 days and 50%* of the Plan allowance plus the difference between the Plan allowance and the billed amount

rows.High Option Benefits: Services provided by a hospital: Outpatient
rows.You pay: In-network: 20%* of other hospital charges Out-of-network: 50%* of other hospital charges
In-network: 30%* of the Plan allowance Out-of-network: 30%* of the Plan allowance and any difference between our allowance and the billed amount

rows.High Option Benefits: Mental health and substance use disorder treatment:

rows.You pay: Network pharmacy, 30-day supply: • Generic - $10 copay • Preferred Brand - 25% up to $250 • Non-Preferred Brand - 40% up to $400
Mail order pharmacy, 90-day supply: • Generic - $25 copay • Preferred Brand - 25% up to $500 • Non-Preferred Brand - 40% up to $800
Charges in excess of the scheduled amounts for diagnostic and preventive service, restorations, and extractions

rows.High Option Benefits: Protection against catastrophic costs (your catastrophic protection out-of-pocket maximum):
rows.You pay: In-network - $7,500 Self Only ($15,000 Self Plus One or Self and Family) per year Out-of-Network - $20,000 Self Only ($40,000 Self Plus One or Self and Family) per year
